label: the side
description: The side is originated first: the ensemble's home margin is mapped to a handicap through the same empirical residual distribution that prices pushes, so the spread is the first number a board can show.

label: the total
description: The total is originated second and independently of the side: it is a separate two-member ensemble over the same walk-forward training windows, so no information from the spread leaks into it.

label: the moneyline
description: The moneyline is originated third because it is priced from the side's margin prediction: the win/tie/loss probabilities come from the margin distribution at zero, and the two-way quote adds the modelled hold.
published_as: originated odds, market odds, probability difference
